product_metadata.title: Versatile Metal Flower Arrangement, Candle Holder Stand Set for Wedding Party Dinner Centerpiece Event Restaurant Hotel Decoration (Twist Style, 10 x L)
features: FRIENDLY REMINDER: The color is some kind between gold and rose gold. Due to the light and screen difference, the item's color may be slightly different from the pictures.

MULTIFUNCTIONAL: You may put artificial flower ball(which is sold in our store) on top of the stand as a great decoration for special days especially for wedding. You may put sented candle on top of the stand and help you relax after 1 days hard working. It is also a good choice for restaurant hotel to create gracious elegance when you put led tealight holder on it. It is a extremely elegant decorations even there is no fake flowers or candles on it!

APPLICATION: This set standing candle stand is great for adding a decorative touch to any room's decor. Wonderful accent piece for coffee tables or side tables. Perfect for everyday use, wedding, events, aromatherapy, Spa, Reiki, Meditation, birthdays, celebration ceremonies, fancy dinner parties and candlelight dinner, holiday dinners and vintage bridal showers.

QUALITY MATERIAL: Our flower & candle holder especially for wedding centerpieces are made of zinc alloy which is anti rust to create each elegant wedding flower holder. Use soft cloth to clean and dry. Not dishwasher safe. Do not use harsh chemicals or abrasives.

ASSEMBLY NEEDED: This wedding candelabra is made from a few different segments and we have put the installation instructions in the package. Please install them as the picture shows. We also list 5 different colors of artificial flowerball in our store, which is applicable for this product!
